tv/week.overview: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

tv/week.name: MobLand
tv/week.overview: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

tv/week.name: Treasure Island
tv/week.overview: Young Jim Hawkins and his mother Bess come into possession of a legendary pirate’s treasure map and are drawn into a deadly voyage across the Atlantic, where Jim is forced to navigate mutiny, violence and betrayal, leaving him forever changed.

tv/week.name: Ted Lasso
tv/week.overview: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, moves to England when he's hired to manage a soccer team—despite having no experience. With cynical players and a doubtful town, will he get them to see the Ted Lasso Way?

tv/week.name: Slow Horses
tv/week.overview: Follow a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents—and their obnoxious boss, the notorious Jackson Lamb—as they navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend England from sinister forces.

tv/week.name: One Piece
tv/week.overview:
Years ago, the fearsome Pirate King, Gol D. Roger was executed leaving a huge pile of treasure and the famous "One Piece" behind. Whoever claims the "One Piece" will be named the new King of the Pirates.

Monkey D. Luffy, a boy who consumed a "Devil Fruit," decides to follow in the footsteps of his idol, the pirate Shanks, and find the One Piece. It helps, of course, that his body has the properties of rubber and that he's surrounded by a bevy of skilled fighters and thieves to help him along the way.

Luffy will do anything to get the One Piece and become King of the Pirates!

tv/week.name: Natural High
tv/week.overview: Come and join Shen Teng and his friends as they step away from the bustling crowded cities and reconnect with the beautiful wild nature.

tv/week.name: Avatar: Seven Havens
tv/week.overview: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

tv/week.name: East of Eden
tv/week.overview: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

tv/week.name: Black Clover
tv/week.overview: Asta and Yuno are two orphans who want the same thing: to become the Wizard King. Locked in a friendly rivalry, they work hard towards their goal. While Yuno excels at magic, Asta has a problem uncommon in this world: he has no powers! But, on the day they receive their grimoires, they surprise everyone. To reach their goal, they’ll each find their own path to greatness—with or without magic.

tv/week.name: TYSON
tv/week.overview: Explore the explosive life of Mike Tyson — one of the most feared and fascinating figures in sports history.

tv/week.name: 100 Days of Deception
tv/week.overview: Hoping for freedom, Gyeongseong's top pickpocket infiltrates the Japanese colonial government to steal secrets — only to fall for her target's son.

tv/week.name: Crystal Lake
tv/week.overview: Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?

tv/week.name: Marshals
tv/week.overview: With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Kayce Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana, where he and his teammates must balance family, duty and the high psychological cost that comes with serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence.

tv/week.name: Brothers
tv/week.overview: Hollywood actors Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson have been best friends for years, but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.

tv/week.name: Bleach
tv/week.overview: For as long as he can remember, Ichigo Kurosaki has been able to see ghosts. But when he meets Rukia, a Soul Reaper who battles evil spirits known as Hollows, he finds his life is changed forever. Now, with a newfound wealth of spiritual energy, Ichigo discovers his true calling: to protect the living and the dead from evil.

tv/week.name: Between Steps
tv/week.overview: Minjae, a former swimmer, lost a leg to illness. Now a PhD student, he's built a quiet, controlled life, until Yujin, a master's student starting over after losing her way, throws it off balance. In a robotics lab, their romance turns fiery, bittersweet, and tender.

tv/week.name: The Lament of Autumn
tv/week.overview: In the turbulent era of the Republic of China, student Ye Pingjun takes a job at a Western Hunan meeting house to fund her mother’s medical care. However, she's unexpectedly caught in the crossfire of an assassination attempt against the powerful Yu family’s fifth son, Yu Changxuan, and ends up accused of a crime she didn’t commit. Pingjun strikes a bold bargain: if Changxuan cannot identify the true culprit within ten days, he must clear her name. What begins as a high-stakes investigation quickly evolves into a calculated courtship as Changxuan maneuvers to win her heart while hiding a complex web of secrets. Will their blossoming romance survive the encroaching shadows of war, or will the secrets of their past pull them apart?

tv/week.name: South Park
tv/week.overview: Follow the misadventures of four irreverent grade-schoolers in the quiet, dysfunctional town of South Park, Colorado.

tv/week.name: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-
tv/week.original_name: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活
tv/week.overview: Natsuki Subaru, an ordinary high school  student, is on his way home from the convenience store when he finds  himself transported to another world. As he's lost and confused in a new  world where he doesn't even know left from right, the only person to  reach out to him was a beautiful girl with silver hair. Determined to  repay her somehow for saving him from his own despair, Subaru agrees to  help the girl find something she's looking for.

tv/week.name: Reacher
tv/week.overview: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

tv/week.name: NCIS
tv/week.overview: From murder and espionage to terrorism and stolen submarines, a team of special agents investigates any crime that has any connection to Navy and Marine Corps personnel, regardless of rank or position.

tv/week.name: Last Seen
tv/week.overview: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.

tv/week.name: The Apothecary Diaries
tv/week.overview: Maomao lived a peaceful life with her apothecary father. Until one day, she's sold as a lowly servant to the emperor's palace. But she wasn't meant for a compliant life among royalty. So when imperial heirs fall ill, she decides to step in and find a cure! This catches the eye of Jinshi, a handsome palace official who promotes her. Now, she's making a name for herself solving medical mysteries!

tv/week.name: Against the Current
tv/week.overview: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

tv/week.name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
tv/week.original_name: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険
tv/week.overview: Follow the intergenerational feud between the Joestar Family and various forces of evil, the most prominent of which is Dio Brando and his followers.

tv/week.name: Merry Berry Love
tv/week.overview: When star Korean spatial designer Lee Yubin loses everything, he heads off to a Japanese island. There, he meets Karin, a resilient strawberry farmer. Hailing from different worlds, their lives collide in a big misunderstanding. Buckle up for "Merry Berry Love," a sweet and sour Korea-Japan rom-com.

tv/week.name: Has Fallen
tv/week.overview: A protection officer and an MI6 operative team up after a terrorist attack. They suspect a mole as they race to thwart a larger conspiracy threatening Paris.

tv/week.name: Small Prophets
tv/week.overview: The magical and mundane unfold in a suburban shed as a lonely man stumbles on the supernatural.

tv/week.name: The Trap
tv/week.overview: Follow famous author Lisa Konrad, who has not left her house for a decade after witnessing the murder of her sister. One night she sees who she believes was the murdered on television, and decides to use herself as bait to catch them.

tv/week.name: American Horror Story
tv/week.overview: An anthology horror drama series centering on different characters and locations, including a house with a murderous past, an asylum, a witch coven, a freak show, a hotel, a farmhouse in Roanoke, a cult, the apocalypse and a summer camp.

tv/week.name: Blue Box
tv/week.overview: Taiki Inomata loves badminton, but he has a long way to go before he can reach nationals. When Taiki sees upperclassman Chinatsu Kano practicing her heart out on the girls’ basketball team, he falls for her hard. After an unexpected turn of events brings the two closer together, sports might not be the first thing on their minds anymore!

tv/week.name: American Horror Story
tv/week.overview: An anthology horror drama series centering on different characters and locations, including a house with a murderous past, an asylum, a witch coven, a freak show, a hotel, a farmhouse in Roanoke, a cult, the apocalypse and a summer camp.

tv/week.name: The Simpsons
tv/week.overview: Set in Springfield, the average American town, the show focuses on the antics and everyday adventures of the Simpson family; Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie, as well as a virtual cast of thousands. Since the beginning, the series has been a pop culture icon, attracting hundreds of celebrities to guest star. The show has also made name for itself in its fearless satirical take on politics, media and American life in general.

tv/week.name: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle
tv/week.original_name: 千歳くんはラムネ瓶のなか
tv/week.overview: Saku Chitose is a student at Fujishi High School, the most prestigious school in Fukui Prefecture. Outstanding in class, on the field, and in his social life, Saku attracts attention, good and bad. Naturally, he is surrounded by a circle of friends anyone would be happy to have. Now in the spring of his second year, with a new class, Saku is asked to help a shut-in classmate return to school life.

tv/week.name: Dark Matter
tv/week.overview: Jason Dessen is abducted into an alternate version of his life. To get back to his real family, he embarks on a harrowing journey to save them from the most terrifying foe imaginable: himself.

tv/week.name: Coven Academy
tv/week.overview: A coven protects their magic school from a dark fate.

tv/week.name: Haunted Hotel
tv/week.overview: After inheriting a hotel from her late brother, a single mom moves in with his good-natured ghost — and high-maintenance guests who will never check out.

tv/week.name: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me
tv/week.original_name: 塩対応の佐藤さんが俺にだけ甘い
tv/week.overview: Sato may be the most beautiful girl in school but she's also the coldest, never smiling at anyone. When her classmate Oshio spots her at a café, he learns Sato's secret: she's actually just shy and clumsy. As Sato and Oshio bond over their shared interests in photography and desserts, a sweet romance starts to blossom between two socially awkward people.

tv/week.name: Ranma1/2
tv/week.overview: Akane Tendo meets her new fiancé, Ranma Saotome, a martial arts prodigy with a twist: he magically transforms into a girl upon touching cold water.

tv/week.name: Overgeared
tv/week.original_name: テムパル～アイテムの力～
tv/week.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

tv/week.name: Irreplaceable
tv/week.overview: After witnessing her mother's suicide following a divorce, Xu Chi defies her tragic fate by rising from an ordinary graduate to a sharp-witted top consultant. Drawn into the covert revenge scheme of seasoned partner Ye Xinzhi, who mentors her while navigating their growing mutual attraction, the duo confronts a crossroads when professional upheavals collide with their evolving bond.

tv/week.name: Family Guy
tv/week.overview: Sick, twisted, politically incorrect and Freakin' Sweet animated series featuring the adventures of the dysfunctional Griffin family. Bumbling Peter and long-suffering Lois have three kids. Stewie (a brilliant but sadistic baby bent on killing his mother and taking over the world), Meg (the oldest, and is the most unpopular girl in town) and Chris (the middle kid, he's not very bright but has a passion for movies). The final member of the family is Brian - a talking dog and much more than a pet, he keeps Stewie in check whilst sipping Martinis and sorting through his own life issues.

tv/week.name: Inside the Circle
tv/week.overview: Four lifelong friends are caught in a web of blackmail when a leaked video threatens to expose the secrets that could destroy their friendship.

tv/week.name: The Vanishing Beauty
tv/week.overview: Yu Meng, an only child from Jiangsu Zhejiang Shanghai and a popular internet blogger, is admired as a woman with a perfect life. On her fifth wedding anniversary, the bubble of her seemingly flawless happiness shatters. Her model husband is no longer so perfect, and her marriage begins to crack, while she also faces the threat of being financially exploited. With the support of her friends, Yu Meng reexamines her life and fights to take back control.

tv/week.name: Firefly Wedding
tv/week.overview: Satoko Kirigaya has everything a noblewoman could want—except time. With her life running out, she’s determined to marry well and make her father proud. But when a ruthless assassin kidnaps her, she makes a desperate offer: “Marry me, and we’ll have it all.” Shinpei Goto accepts, only to become dangerously obsessed. Now Satoko must choose between duty and a love that could consume them both.

tv/week.name: SpongeBob SquarePants
tv/week.overview: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

tv/week.name: GET JIRO
tv/week.overview: In a post-apocalyptic, near-future Los Angeles where culinary culture reigns supreme, the world's most powerful figures are chefs, and food is both currency and a demarcation of class, the mysterious sushi chef Jiro sets out on a quest for vengeance.

tv/week.name: FBI
tv/week.overview: The New York office of the FBI brings to bear all their talents, intellect and technical expertise on major cases in order to keep their city and the country safe.

tv/week.name: WAR
tv/week.overview: An anthology series set in the elite world of London law following two rival firms, Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne, as they face off in a different headline-making legal battle each season.

tv/week.name: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
tv/week.original_name: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。 ～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～
tv/week.overview: Rein spent years enhancing his guildmates’ gear with magic, only to be expelled the moment he enchanted everything. Unfazed, Rein steals back his magic, pours it into his own sword, and makes the best of his newfound freedom as he sets off as an adventurer. Along the way, Rein gathers a band of fellow outcasts and together they fight monsters and carve out their place in an enchanted world.

tv/week.name: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
tv/week.original_name: 無職転生 ～異世界行ったら本気だす～
tv/week.overview: When a 34-year-old underachiever gets run over by a truck, his story doesn't end there. Reincarnated in a new world as an infant, Rudy will seize every opportunity to live the life he's always wanted. Armed with new friends, some freshly acquired magical abilities, and the courage to do the things he's always dreamed of, he's embarking on an epic adventure—with all of his past experience intact!

tv/week.name: Lioness
tv/week.overview: Cruz Manuelos, a rough-around-the-edges but passionate young Marine, is recruited to join the CIA's Lioness Engagement Team to help bring down a terrorist organization from within. Joe, the station chief of the Lioness program, is tasked with training, managing and leading her female undercover operatives.

tv/week.name: Silo
tv/week.overview: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

tv/week.name: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story
tv/week.overview: Trapped in a cruel Victorian-era household, Lizzie Borden kills her parents in a gory ax murder that shocks the nation.

tv/week.name: American Hostage
tv/week.overview: A psychological thriller anthology series focusing on a different hostage case every season.

tv/week.name: Futurama
tv/week.overview: The adventures of a late-20th-century New York City pizza delivery boy, Philip J. Fry, who, after being unwittingly cryogenically frozen for one thousand years, finds employment at Planet Express, an interplanetary delivery company in the retro-futuristic 31st century.

tv/week.name: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
tv/week.overview: In a student council filled with weirdos, one new member is about to have a hell of a school year! Mizunoe Ume just wanted to avoid repeating a grade when he joined the student council. After all, it seemed like an easy fix to his current academic problems. But then, he met his fellow council members. Each of them is eccentric in their own way—one's an airhead, another's scary, one's secretly a pervert, but all in all, they're just really weird! Yet somehow, they're also oddly cute and endearing. Which means Mizunoe is stuck with them and all the chaos they bring to the table. Get ready for a slice-of-life story that's irresistibly charming, quirky, and a little bit naughty!

tv/week.name: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden
tv/week.original_name: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン 病弱令嬢に転生した神殺しの武人の華麗なる無双録
tv/week.overview: A dying girl is saved when a fallen warrior’s soul is placed in her body, giving her new life, healing powers, and an unstoppable thirst for battle that brings chaos in its wake.

tv/week.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
tv/week.original_name: 転生したらスライムだった件
tv/week.overview: Corporate worker Mikami Satoru is stabbed by a random killer, and is reborn to an alternate world. But he turns out to be reborn a slime! Thrown into this new world with the name Rimuru, he begins his quest to create a world that’s welcoming to all races.

tv/week.name: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality
tv/week.overview: A poor and ordinary boy from a village joins a minor sect in Jiang Hu and becomes an Unofficial Disciple by chance. How will Han Li, a commoner by birth, establish a foothold for himself in his sect? With his mediocre aptitude, he must successfully traverse the treacherous path of cultivation and avoid the notice of those who may do him harm. This is a story of an ordinary mortal who, against all odds, clashes with devilish demons and ancient celestials in order to find his own path towards immortality.

tv/week.name: Time
tv/week.overview: Guilt, violence and impossible choices – what does it take to survive? Tense, gritty and heartbreaking – Jimmy McGovern's award-winning prison drama, with an all-star cast.

tv/week.name: The Rookie
tv/week.overview: Starting over isn't easy, especially for small-town guy John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of being an LAPD officer. As the force's oldest rookie, he's met with skepticism from some higher-ups who see him as just a walking midlife crisis.

tv/week.name: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga
tv/week.overview: In 1990s Los Angeles, Wanda and Leon fight to take West Coast rap mainstream while gang wars erupt and record labels move to exploit hip hop culture for their own gain.

tv/week.name: Kill Jackie
tv/week.overview: Jackie Price has been living a wealthy, luxurious life for the past 20 years after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life begins to feel a little boring, she discovers that The Seven Demons, a group of the world’s most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her.

tv/week.name: kiDnap GAME
tv/week.overview: Across seven Asian cities, strangers are forced into a deadly game where only one can save their loved one by beating the others.

tv/week.name: Mission: Yozakura Family
tv/week.overview: Taiyo Asano has been on his own ever since his parents died and the only one who seems to care for him is his childhood friend and classmate, Mutsumi Yozakura. But Mutsumi has a secret—she is the head of a family of spies! And on top of that, her brother Kyoichiro is dangerously protective of her! To stop Kyoichiro from killing him, Taiyo and Mutsumi must take the ultimate leap—marriage! Because in the Yozakura family, family cannot kill family.

tv/week.name: A Prophet
tv/week.overview: After his family is wiped out by the Tianxiang Sect, Shangguan Chengming goes undercover to take revenge. With the help of Jiang Feiyan, they use a series of scams to expose corruption and fight for justice.

tv/week.name: A Certain Dark Item
tv/week.original_name: とある暗部の少女共棲
tv/week.overview: In Academy City, psychic powers promise a brighter future. But beneath the city's peaceful surface lurks a merciless dark side. ITEM, an elite team of four girls with deadly abilities, carries out dangerous missions that can never see the light of day. When a fifth girl enters their lives, ITEM is drawn deeper into a world of violence, brutality, and moral corruption.

tv/week.name: A Love Other Than Yours
tv/week.overview: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

tv/week.name: The Gentlemen
tv/week.overview: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to an enormous weed empire — and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

tv/week.name: NCIS: New York
tv/week.overview: Special Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to the NCIS field office and partners with a roguish agent, Nick Schaeffer, to help lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

tv/week.name: NCIS: New York
tv/week.overview: Special Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to the NCIS field office and partners with a roguish agent, Nick Schaeffer, to help lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

tv/week.name: CIA
tv/week.overview: When by-the-book FBI Special Agent Bill Goodman is loaned out to a clandestine CIA/FBI task force, he finds himself teamed up with secretive and roguish CIA case officer Colin Glass. Together they work covert operations in New York, uncovering international plots, terrorist cells, and geopolitical secrets.

tv/week.name: Tokyo Revengers
tv/week.overview: Takemichi Hanagaki is a freelancer that’s reached the absolute pits of despair in his life. He finds out that the only girlfriend he ever had, in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, had been killed by the ruthless Tokyo Manji Gang. The day after hearing about her death, he’s standing on the station platform and ends up being pushed over onto the tracks by a herd of people. He closes his eyes thinking he’s about to die, but when he opens his eyes back up, he somehow had gone back in time 12 years. Now that he’s back living the best days of his life, Takemichi decides to get revenge on his life.

tv/week.name: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner
tv/week.original_name: ダークサモナーとデキている
tv/week.overview: Amona, a dark summoner and demi-human girl who's too weak to resist her desires, and Roni, an overly serious priest! Roni welcomes Aruni as a new member to his adventuring party. Everyone expected the two would clash and become sworn enemies. But, to their surprise and on their first day together, they have a one-night stand...!

tv/week.name: JUJUTSU KAISEN
tv/week.overview: Yuji Itadori is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a classmate who has been attacked by curses, he eats the finger of Ryomen Sukuna, taking the curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with Ryomen Sukuna. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Satoru Gojo, Itadori is admitted to Tokyo Jujutsu High School, an organization that fights the curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a curse to exorcise a curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

tv/week.name: Cupertino
tv/week.overview: A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

tv/week.name: Outlander: Blood of My Blood
tv/week.overview: From the battlefields of World War I to the rugged Highlands of 18th century Scotland, two fated couples must defy the forces that seek to tear them apart, unfolding in surprising and unforeseen ways in this romantic saga that unfolds across time.

tv/week.name: Line of Fire
tv/week.overview: A family of law enforcement agents bridges personal differences and crosses professional boundaries as they tackle cases for the FBI, US Marshals, Secret Service and Department of Justice. After a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy, they must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice … even if it means betraying their sworn code.

tv/week.name: Tracker
tv/week.overview: Lone-wolf survivalist Colter Shaw roams the country as a “reward seeker,” using his expert tracking skills to help private citizens and law enforcement solve all manner of mysteries while contending with his own fractured family.

tv/week.name: Reincarnated as a Sword
tv/week.overview: Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saves a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, becomes his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here. Together, the strange duo's journey has only just begun!

tv/week.name: Fool in Love
tv/week.original_name: คนโง่รักเข(ล)า
tv/week.overview: A powerful heir uses business to pursue an aristocrat, only to become hopelessly entangled in a romantic trap of his own making.

tv/week.name: The Terminal List
tv/week.overview: Navy SEAL Commander James Reece turns to vengeance as he investigates the mysterious forces behind the murder of his entire platoon. Free from the military's command structure, Reece applies the lessons he's learned from nearly two decades of warfare to hunt down the people responsible.

tv/week.name: The Lowdown
tv/week.overview: Follow the gritty exploits of citizen journalist Lee Raybon, a self-proclaimed Tulsa "truthstorian" whose obsession with the truth is always getting him into trouble.

tv/week.name: Stranger Things
tv/week.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

tv/week.name: Sheriff Country
tv/week.overview: Mickey Fox investigates criminal activity and patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater while contending with her ex-con father and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter.

tv/week.name: The Ramparts of Ice
tv/week.overview: Weighed down by memories she can't shake, high schooler Koyuki Hikawa keeps everyone at arm's length — until three schoolmates draw her out of her shell.

tv/week.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
tv/week.overview: In a dystopia riddled with corruption and cybernetic implants, a talented but reckless street kid strives to become a mercenary outlaw — an edgerunner.

tv/week.name: Tulsa King
tv/week.overview: New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi is released from prison after 25 years and exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a crew.

tv/week.name: King of Comedy
tv/week.overview: A spirited young villager and her reluctant ally race against a seven-day demolition deadline, battling viral mishaps, copyright disputes, and a rival village’s sabotage to save their coastal hometown—and find love along the way.

tv/week.name: The Boys
tv/week.overview: A group of vigilantes known informally as “The Boys” set out to take down corrupt superheroes with no more than blue-collar grit and a willingness to fight dirty.
